theme.name: Theme Foundryborne
theme.hint: Enables the styling of Foundryborne's application windows to match Enhanced UI's styling

themeChat.name: Theme Chat Cards
themeChat.hint: Enables the styling of chat cards to match Enhanced UI's styling

enableMinisheet.name: Enable Mini Sheets
enableMinisheet.hint: Enables the mini sheet displayed at the bottom of the screen while a token is selected

minisheetScale.name: Minisheet Scale
minisheetScale.hint: Adjusts the scale of the mini sheets to better accomodate smaller or larger screens (default: 1)

showTooltip.name: Show Card Tooltips
showTooltip.hint: Shows tooltips for cards when hovering the icon

currencyLabel.name: Show Currency Labels
currencyLabel.hint: Shows the labels for each currency on top of their values

beastformPortrait.name: Use Beastform Portrait
beastformPortrait.hint: When in beastform, change the character's portrait to the form's Subject Texture

favoritesDisplayMode.name: Minisheet Panel
favoritesDisplayMode.hint: Quick Access is your own hand-picked shortcut list. Standard shows Inventory (weapons/armor/consumables/items) and Hand (domain cards and class/ancestry/community features) as two separate buttons.

cardHandPosition.name: Card Hand Position
cardHandPosition.hint: Where the hand opens relative to the minisheet.

enablePartyOverview.name: Enable Party Overview Widget
enablePartyOverview.hint: Shows a small draggable HUD (GM only) with each party member's HP, Stress, and portrait

partyOverviewLayout.name: Party Overview Layout
partyOverviewLayout.hint: Horizontal: one column per member. Vertical: one row per member.

countdownDisplayMode.name: Countdown Tracker: Display Mode
countdownDisplayMode.hint: Choose how the countdown value is displayed.

countdownIconShape.name: Countdown Tracker: Icon Shape
countdownIconShape.hint: Choose the shape of the countdown icons.

countdownBarOrientation.name: Countdown Tracker: Bar Orientation
countdownBarOrientation.hint: Choose the orientation of the progress bar (for square icons).

countdownEnableVisualOverlay.name: Countdown Tracker: Enable Fill Overlay
countdownEnableVisualOverlay.hint: Show the filled progress overlay (Bar or Clock).

countdownFillType.name: Countdown Tracker: Fill Type
countdownFillType.hint: Choose between a color overlay or a grayscale filter method.

countdownInvertProgress.name: Countdown Tracker: Invert Fill Overlay
countdownInvertProgress.hint: Fill the empty space instead of the current value.

countdownFillColor.name: Countdown Tracker: Fill Overlay Color
countdownFillColor.hint: Color for the filled progress overlay.

countdownEnableVisualBorder.name: Countdown Tracker: Enable Border Progress
countdownEnableVisualBorder.hint: Show a progress border around the icon.

countdownInvertBorder.name: Countdown Tracker: Invert Border Progress
countdownInvertBorder.hint: Fill the empty space instead of the current value for the border.

countdownBorderStyle.name: Countdown Tracker: Border Style
countdownBorderStyle.hint: Choose the style of the progress border (for square icons).

countdownBorderEdge.name: Countdown Tracker: Border Edge
countdownBorderEdge.hint: Choose which edge to display the border on.

countdownGmAlwaysShowNumbers.name: Countdown Tracker: GM Always Shows Numbers
countdownGmAlwaysShowNumbers.hint: If enabled, the GM will always see the numerical value even if Display Mode is set to Visual.

quickAccess.title: Quick Access
quickAccess.alreadyInQuickAccess: Item is already in Quick Access
